name: beaver-workspace-monorepo
description: Collaborative Office Workspace Platform using Microservices Architecture

scripts.install-all: npm install && npm run install-services && npm run install-client
scripts.install-services: npm install --prefix services/auth-service && npm install --prefix services/workspace-service && npm install --prefix services/chat-service && npm install --prefix services/audit-service && npm install --prefix services/ai-service && npm install --prefix services/notification-service
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail "npm run dev-auth" "npm run dev-workspace" "npm run dev-chat" "npm run dev-audit" "npm run dev-ai" "npm run dev-notification" "npm run dev-client"
